draft_en.subject: Compact industrial switches and gigabit fibre converters under the CommFront label
draft_en.body:
Hello CommFront team,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "16 Port Industrial PoE Switch" on 10 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

Serial and Modbus are yours; for the compact industrial Ethernet switches and gigabit fibre converters in the range, under the CommFront label from small lots, -40 to 75 C, CE/RoHS/FCC: DIN-rail 5 x Gigabit unmanaged, 12-36 V DC - model STI-050GE - $18.5 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity; wide 12-58 V version $25); 8 x Gigabit - STI-080GE - $34.0; Gigabit media converter, 1 x RJ45 + 1 x SFP slot - STI-110GE - $26.5.

One question: which of the two - the 5/8-port switch or the converter - would you want a sample quote on first?

Best regards,
Simon
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
